findings.title: 2 of 20 jobs miss their deadline
findings.detail: Worst lateness 200 us; affected threads: safety_loop (2). Worst-case response time 2800 us.
findings.recommendation: Run `chronoscope fix` to derive a counterfactually verified priority/inheritance/partition configuration, then re-audit.
findings.qnx_reference: System Architecture > What is Real Time and Why Do I Need It?

findings.title: 2 adaptive-partition budget exhaustion(s)
findings.detail: A partition consumed its percentage budget inside the averaging window; its threads were throttled until the window rolled over.
findings.recommendation: Rebalance partition budgets, mark genuinely critical threads critical, or shorten the workload in the non-critical partition.

timing_evidence.purpose: Structured timing evidence for an ISO 26262 / IEC 62304 / DO-178C style safety case. This is engineering evidence, NOT a certification artifact or a claim of compliance.
timing_evidence.scheduling_model: QNX Neutrino: 256 priority levels, message-driven priority inheritance, SCHED_FIFO/RR/SPORADIC, adaptive partitioning
timing_evidence.reproducibility: Deterministic discrete-event replay; re-run `chronoscope simulate MODEL` to reproduce exactly.
